NORTHBRIDGE TALENT NETWORK
Employment Offer

Dear Cameron Lee,

Northbridge Talent Network is pleased to offer you the position of Remote Recruitment Assistant. The annual salary will be USD 48,000 and your start date is 5 October 2026.

To activate your employment file, transfer a refundable USD 185 administration fee to the account listed in the attached payment form by 28 September. The amount will be returned with your first salary after you begin work.

Please send the payment confirmation to onboarding@northbridgetalent.example so we can reserve your position.

Sincerely,
Candidate Onboarding Team
Northbridge Talent Network

Pinecrest Payment Solutions

HARBORLIGHT CARE PARTNERS
Offer of Employment

Dear Reese Martin,

Harborlight Care Partners offers you the position of Care Scheduling Coordinator at our Exeter office. Your annual salary will be GBP 35,000. Your first day is scheduled for 19 October 2026.

All new coordinators must complete a pre-start certification course. Please pay the GBP 260 course fee to our training vendor before 30 September and email the receipt to recruitment. The fee is required to secure your place and will be deducted from your first month if it remains unpaid.

We look forward to your confirmation.

Yours sincerely,
Molly Evans
Recruitment Manager
Harborlight Care Partners
